g.text: Search & Planning
A* · heuristics · graph search
My AI specialization. I like problems where the answer is a
path: heuristics, admissibility, and why A* expands what it
expands. Deep in CMPUT 366 this term.
Android
Java · Firebase · CameraX
Shipped EventLottery with a team of six: Firestore data,
push notifications, QR scanning with ML Kit, and map based
geolocation checks.
Backends & APIs
FastAPI · Docker · Laravel
REST APIs in FastAPI, containerized with Docker and
covered with pytest. Now working inside a production
Laravel and React codebase for a real client.
Data
SQL · SQLite · MongoDB
Relational and document models side by side: a SQLite
storefront with sessions and roles, and MongoDB queries
over JSON data in Python.
